name: Toriko 2
source:
A woman comes to main character as a tutor. As soon as she recognizes a sadist in protagonist, she requests to train a strange girl Rikako as a slave, as well as her two sisters. This isolated mountain cottage becomes a territory of domination and obedience.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个女人以家教的身份来到主人公面前。她一发现主人公的虐待狂本性，就要求他将一个名叫梨花子的奇怪女孩连同她的两个姐妹一起调教成奴隶。这座与世隔绝的山间小屋变成了支配与服从的领地。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
